{{Sagittarius}}
Sagittarius 23 is the 23rd day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 23rd day of Sagittarius, and it is a Tuesday. It corresponds to ISO week 4, weekday 2.

Its informal Japanese name is 1宮23日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 23|Chapter 23]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152043}}.
